name: @intentic/webext
description: The browser extension that lets an intentic sandbox work in the user's own signed-in browser, one outbound WebSocket, an MCP tool surface, and per-site grants enforced by the browser

scripts.build: node ../../_tools/scripts/build/clean-outputs.mjs dist dist.zip && esbuild src/background/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome116 --minify --outfile=dist/background.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/content/pair-bridge.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome116 --minify --outfile=dist/pair-bridge.js --log-level=warning && esbuild src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome116 --minify --outfile=dist/popup.js --log-level=warning && cp -R static/. dist/ && node scripts/stamp-manifest.mjs
